# zlaset

> Initializes a complex matrix to BETA on the diagonal and ALPHA on the.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```js
import zlaset from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/zlaset';
```

### Layout API

Takes a storage layout (`order`) and leading dimensions, like CBLAS/LAPACKE.

```js
zlaset( order, uplo, M, N, alpha, beta, A, LDA ) → Complex128Array
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `order` | `Layout` | Storage layout ('row-major' or 'column-major') |
| `uplo` | `"upper" \| "lower" \| "all"` | `'upper'` or `'lower'`, otherwise full |
| `M` | `integer` | Number of rows |
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Number of columns |
| `alpha` | `Complex128` | Complex off-diagonal value |
| `beta` | `Complex128` | Complex diagonal value |
| `A` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>m × N</sub> | **out** · Input matrix |
| ↳ `LDA` | `PositiveInteger` | Leading dimension of `A` |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `uplo`: Specifies the part of the matrix A to be set.

  -   `= 'U'`: Upper triangular part is set. The lower triangle is unchanged.
  -   `= 'L'`: Lower triangular part is set. The upper triangle is unchanged. Otherwise:  All of the matrix A is set.
- `M`: On entry, M specifies the number of rows of A.
- `N`: On entry, N specifies the number of columns of A.
- `alpha`: All the offdiagonal array elements are set to `ALPHA`.
- `beta`: All the diagonal array elements are set to `BETA`.
- `A`: On entry, the m by n matrix A. On exit, $A(i,j) = \mathrm{ALPHA}$, $1 \le i \le m$, $1 \le j \le n$, $i \ne j$;

  $$
  A(i,i) = \mathrm{BETA} , 1 \le i \le \min (m,n)
  $$

</details>

**Returns** `Complex128Array`: output array

**Throws**

- `TypeError` first argument must be a valid order
- `TypeError` second argument must be one of the following: "upper", "lower", "all"

### Strided (strided) API

Takes explicit strides and offsets for every array. Use it for views, sub-matrices and non-unit strides.

```js
zlaset.strided( uplo, M, N, alpha, beta, A, strideA1, strideA2, offsetA ) → Complex128Array
```

Matrix shapes are logical (rows × columns). The reference's leading dimension (`LDA`, …) is replaced by the two strides and the offset.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `uplo` | `"upper" \| "lower" \| "all"` | `'upper'` or `'lower'`, otherwise full |
| `M` | `integer` | Number of rows |
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Number of columns |
| `alpha` | `Complex128` | Complex off-diagonal value |
| `beta` | `Complex128` | Complex diagonal value |
| `A` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>m × N</sub> | **out** · Input/output matrix |
| ↳ `strideA1` | `integer` | Stride of the first dimension of A (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `strideA2` | `integer` | Stride of the second dimension of A (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `offsetA` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for A (in complex elements) |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `uplo`: Specifies the part of the matrix A to be set.

  -   `= 'U'`: Upper triangular part is set. The lower triangle is unchanged.
  -   `= 'L'`: Lower triangular part is set. The upper triangle is unchanged. Otherwise:  All of the matrix A is set.
- `M`: On entry, M specifies the number of rows of A.
- `N`: On entry, N specifies the number of columns of A.
- `alpha`: All the offdiagonal array elements are set to `ALPHA`.
- `beta`: All the diagonal array elements are set to `BETA`.
- `A`: On entry, the m by n matrix A. On exit, $A(i,j) = \mathrm{ALPHA}$, $1 \le i \le m$, $1 \le j \le n$, $i \ne j$;

  $$
  A(i,i) = \mathrm{BETA} , 1 \le i \le \min (m,n)
  $$

</details>

**Returns** `Complex128Array`: A

**Throws**

- `TypeError` first argument must be one of the following: "upper", "lower", "all"
- `RangeError` second argument must be a nonnegative integer
- `RangeError` third argument must be a nonnegative integer

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="notes">

## Notes

-   `zlaset()` corresponds to the reference LAPACK routine [`ZLASET`](https://github.com/Reference-LAPACK/lapack/blob/v3.12.0/SRC/zlaset.f).

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

```js
import Complex128Array from '@stdlib/array/complex128/lib/index.js';
import Complex128 from '@stdlib/complex/float64/ctor/lib/index.js';
import reinterpret from '@stdlib/strided/base/reinterpret-complex128/lib/index.js';
import zlaset from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/zlaset';

const N = 3;
const A = new Complex128Array( N * N );
const alpha = new Complex128( 2.0, -1.0 ); // off-diagonal value
const beta = new Complex128( 1.0, 0.0 ); // diagonal value

// Using the standard interface (set the strictly upper triangle to alpha and the diagonal to beta):
zlaset( 'row-major', 'upper', N, N, alpha, beta, A, N );
console.log( reinterpret( A, 0 ) ); // eslint-disable-line no-console

// Using the strided interface (set the full matrix):
zlaset.strided( 'all', N, N, alpha, beta, A, N, 1, 0 );
console.log( reinterpret( A, 0 ) ); // eslint-disable-line no-console
```

</section>
